title: 3.5.8 Lab: Dot vs. Bracket — When You're Forced to Bracket
description: Read a key with a space and a key held in a variable, and print every key/value pair with Object.keys. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Build an object with a spaced key
steps.instructions: Create an object that has at least one property whose key contains a space, written in quotes, such as "screen size".

steps.title: Read the spaced key with brackets
steps.instructions: Print the value of the property with the space in its name. Use square brackets with the quoted key.

steps.title: Store a key name in a variable
steps.instructions: Create a variable that holds the name of one of the object's properties, as a string.

steps.title: Read that property with brackets
steps.instructions: Use the variable inside square brackets to print that property's value.

steps.title: Walk every key
steps.instructions: Use Object.keys with a loop to print every key and its value, using brackets to fetch each value.
